name: Pycharm
tagline: Offers out-of-the-box support for Python, databases, Jupyter, Git, Conda, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, Django, Flask, FastAPI, and more.
description: PyCharm offers out-of-the-box support for Python, databases, Jupyter, Git, Conda, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, Django, Flask, FastAPI, and more.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/pycharm:2026.2.20260811@sha256:5ea4f8c48828b48ab4ddd35adac1cd7464975b78897c5afa07f64a947f31ed76
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
